zh.name: 耀嘉音
zh.desc: 繁星为她落座，灯光为她熄灭，新艾利都最闪耀的歌声划破天际。\n舞台之外，她趁着假期，像云朵一样在乐园的晴空下悠游。\n「不论你是谁，不论你来自哪里——这一曲，献给世上独一无二的你！」

1.name: 用鼓点，让群星律动
1.desc: 结界持续期间，我方角色施放造成普攻伤害的攻击后，对命中目标中当前生命值最高的目标额外造成1次等同于本次攻击总伤害值<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>的<u>真实伤害</u>。行迹【鎏金乐章】的能量恢复效果提高至<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>点。

10000017.name: 真实伤害
10000017.desc: 不受任何效果所影响的无属性伤害，本次伤害不视为造成了1次攻击。

2.name: 夕阳落入她眼眸
2.desc: 战技使我方全体目标的攻击力额外提高，提高数值等同于耀嘉音攻击力的<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。天赋【切分音】的伤害提高效果对除普攻外的其他攻击类型也会生效。

3.name: 嘘~不要告诉风儿
3.desc: 战技等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级。

4.name: 一人的日子两面微糊
4.desc: 【高歌，倾落华彩】的伤害倍率提高原倍率的<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>，终结技的伤害倍率提高原倍率的<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。

5.name: 刻录灵魂的唱针
5.desc: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过<unbreak>10</unbreak>级。

6.name: 直到舞台亮灯
6.desc: 结界持续期间，我方全体目标全属性<u>抗性穿透</u>提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。耀嘉音施放终结技后固定恢复<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>点能量，每施放<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>次终结技后可再次触发该效果。战斗开始时，耀嘉音获得<unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>个【切分音】。

30000005.name: 抗性穿透
30000005.desc: 当造成伤害时，无视敌方目标的一部分对应伤害属性的抗性值。

151501.name: 旋足，跃动轻音
151501.desc: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于耀嘉音<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的量子属性伤害。
151501.simple_desc: 对指定敌方单体造成少量量子属性伤害。

151502.name: 虹光为你闪耀
151502.desc: 使我方全体目标攻击力提高，提高数值相当于耀嘉音攻击力的<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>+<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>点，同时使耀嘉音普攻强化为【高歌，倾落华彩】，持续<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>回合，自身每回合开始时持续回合数减1。
151502.simple_desc: 使我方全体目标<color=#f29e38ff>攻击力提高</color>，同时使耀嘉音<color=#f29e38ff>普攻获得强化</color>。

151503.name: 星夜的安可曲
151503.desc: 对敌方全体造成等同于耀嘉音<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的量子属性伤害并展开结界，持续<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>回合，自身每回合开始时结界持续回合数减1。结界持续期间，使敌方全体受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>，我方角色施放普攻攻击敌方后，耀嘉音对本次普攻击中的目标造成1次等同于耀嘉音<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的量子属性<u>附加伤害</u>。
151503.simple_desc: 对敌方全体造成大量量子属性伤害并<color=#f29e38ff>展开结界</color>。结界持续期间，使敌方全体<color=#f29e38ff>受到的伤害提高</color>，我方角色施放普攻后，耀嘉音对被攻击目标造成少量量子属性<u>附加伤害</u>。

10000005.name: 附加伤害
10000005.desc: 使受击者额外受到1次伤害，本次伤害不视为造成了1次攻击。

151504.name: 弹奏银河的讯息
151504.desc: 我方目标攻击敌方时，耀嘉音获得1个【切分音】，每个【切分音】使我方全体目标普攻造成的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>，该效果持续<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>回合，自身每回合开始时持续回合数减1。最多可获得<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>个【切分音】。
151504.simple_desc: 我方目标攻击敌方时，耀嘉音<color=#f29e38ff>获得【切分音】</color>，使我方全体角色<color=#f29e38ff>普攻造成的伤害提高</color>，该效果可叠加。

151505.name: 零号连线
151505.desc:
队伍中包含<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>时：
耀嘉音施放终结技后，解除<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>的<u>控制类负面状态</u>，随后自动施放1次【高歌，倾落华彩】，再立即触发<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>的【利齿修剪法】，使<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>获得1点【咬合力】。该次【利齿修剪法】的攻击结束后，再触发1次<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>的【冰海潜游式】。
<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>施放终结技后，解除耀嘉音的<u>控制类负面状态</u>，随后自动施放1次【冰海潜游式】，再立即触发耀嘉音的【共舞，跃动轻音】，随后使耀嘉音获得1个可插入施放终结技的<u>额外回合</u>。
由【零号连线】触发的攻击在选择主目标时，均优先选择陷入【咬痕】状态的敌方目标。
由【零号连线】触发的普攻均不恢复战技点，由【零号连线】触发的【冰海潜游式】均不消耗【咬合力】。
队伍中不包含<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>时：耀嘉音施放终结技后额外恢复<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点能量。
151505.simple_desc: 队伍中包含<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>时，<color=#f29e38ff>任一方施放终结技后</color>，解除对方的<u>控制类负面状态</u>，随后触发<color=#f29e38ff>多次攻击</color>。\n耀嘉音施放终结技后，<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>获得【咬合力】；<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>施放终结技后，耀嘉音在这些攻击结束后获得1个可插入施放终结技的<u>额外回合</u>。\n队伍中不包含<unbreak>艾莲</unbreak>时，耀嘉音施放终结技后额外<color=#f29e38ff>恢复能量</color>。

10000000.name: 额外回合
10000000.desc: 获得1个不消耗回合数的额外回合，在此回合中无法插入施放终结技。

10000011.name: 控制类负面状态
10000011.desc: 冻结，纠缠，禁锢，支配，怒噪，强烈震荡，异梦，缠禁，恐惧，行动锁定，幸福傀儡，怨火灼身，麻痹。

151506.name: 攻击
151506.desc: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

151507.name: 游梦序曲
151507.desc: 使用秘技后，使下一次战斗开始时自动触发1次战技，此次触发不消耗战技点。
151507.simple_desc: 使用秘技后，下一次战斗开始时<color=#f29e38ff>自动触发1次不消耗战技点的战技</color>。

151508.name: 高歌，倾落华彩
151508.desc: 对敌方全体造成等同于耀嘉音<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的量子属性伤害。
151508.simple_desc: 对敌方全体造成量子属性伤害。

151512.name: 共舞，跃动轻音
151512.desc: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于耀嘉音<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的量子属性伤害，对相邻目标造成等同于耀嘉音<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的量子属性伤害。
151512.simple_desc: 对指定敌方单体造成量子属性伤害，对相邻目标造成少量量子属性伤害。

1.point_desc: 暴击率提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。耀嘉音的攻击力大于<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>时，每超过<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>点攻击力可使自身暴击伤害提高<unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>，最多提高<unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak>。
施放【高歌，倾落华彩】时额外恢复<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点能量。
我方目标施放普攻时，耀嘉音额外获得<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>个【切分音】，拥有【切分音】时，我方全体目标造成的伤害提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。

en.name: Astra Yao
en.desc: The stars take their seats for her, the lights dim for her, and New Eridu's most dazzling voice pierces the sky.\nOffstage, she spends her vacation drifting like a cloud beneath the arcadia's clear sky.\n"Whoever you are, wherever you're from... this song is dedicated to the one and only you!"

1.name: Her Drumbeat Moves the Stars
1.desc: While the Zone is active, after an ally character uses an attack that deals Basic ATK DMG, they additionally deal 1 instance of <u>True DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the total DMG of this attack to the hit target with the highest current HP. The Energy regeneration effect of the Trace "Filigree Aria" increases to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as launching 1 attack.

2.name: The Sun Sets in Her Eyes
2.desc: The Skill increases the ATK of all allies by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Astra Yao's ATK. The DMG Boost effect of Talent "Syncopation" also applies to attack types other than Basic ATK.

3.name: Shh, the Wind Has Ears
3.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

4.name: Toasted Alone on Both Sides
4.desc: The DMG multiplier of "Cadenza Cascade" increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the original multiplier, and the DMG multiplier of the Ultimate increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original multiplier.

5.name: The Stylus Scripts Her Soul
5.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

6.name: Until the Footlights Flare
6.desc: While the Zone is active, all ally targets' All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After Astra Yao uses her Ultimate, regenerates a fixed <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy. This effect can be triggered again after every <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Ultimate(s) used. At the start of combat, Astra Yao gains <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> "Syncopation."

30000005.name: RES PEN
30000005.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

151501.name: Pirouette Pianissimo
151501.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Astra Yao's ATK to one designated enemy.
151501.simple_desc: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated enemy.

151502.name: Shine for You in Every Hue
151502.desc: Increases the ATK of all ally targets by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Astra Yao's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>, and enhances Astra Yao's Basic ATK into "Cadenza Cascade," lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). At the start of this unit's turn, this duration decreases by 1.
151502.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Increases the ATK</color> of all ally targets, and <color=#f29e38ff>enhances Astra Yao's Basic ATK</color>.

151503.name: Astral Encore
151503.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Astra Yao's ATK to all enemies and deploys a Zone that lasts for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). At the start of this unit's turn, the Zone's duration decreases by 1. While the Zone is active, DMG taken by all enemies increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>. After an ally character uses a Basic ATK to attack enemies, Astra Yao deals 1 instance of Quantum <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of her ATK to the target hit by this Basic ATK.
151503.simple_desc: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all enemies and <color=#f29e38ff>deploys a Zone</color>. While the Zone is active, <color=#f29e38ff>increases DMG taken</color> by all enemies. After an ally character uses a Basic ATK, Astra Yao deals minor Quantum <u>Additional DMG</u> to the hit target.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

151504.name: Play the Galaxy's Message
151504.desc: When an ally target attacks an enemy, Astra Yao gains 1 "Syncopation." Each "Syncopation" increases DMG dealt by all ally targets' Basic ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. This effect lasts for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s), and its duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's turn. Astra Yao can gain a maximum of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Syncopation."
151504.simple_desc: When an ally target attacks an enemy, Astra Yao <color=#f29e38ff>gains "Syncopation,"</color> <color=#f29e38ff>increasing the DMG dealt by Basic ATK</color> of all ally characters. This effect is stackable.

151505.name: Zoned In on Zero
151505.desc:
When <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak> is in the team:
After Astra Yao uses her Ultimate, it dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak>, then automatically uses "Cadenza Cascade" 1 time, and immediately triggers <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak>'s "Saw Teeth Trimming", granting <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak> 1 point of "Shark's Gotta Bite". After this "Saw Teeth Trimming" attack ends, it triggers <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak>'s "Ice Sea Diving" 1 time.
After <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak> uses her Ultimate, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from Astra Yao, then automatically uses "Ice Sea Diving" 1 time, immediately triggers Astra Yao's "Minuet Pianissimo", and grants Astra Yao 1 <u>extra turn</u> in which an Ultimate can be inserted.
When attacks triggered by "Zoned In on Zero" select a primary target, they prioritize enemy targets afflicted with "Bite Mark".
Basic ATKs triggered by "Zoned In on Zero" do not recover Skill Points, and "Ice Sea Diving" triggered by "Zoned In on Zero" does not consume "Shark's Gotta Bite".
When <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak> is not in the team: After Astra Yao uses her Ultimate, additionally regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.
151505.simple_desc: When <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak> is in the team, <color=#f29e38ff>after either uses an Ultimate</color>, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from the other, then triggers <color=#f29e38ff>multiple attacks</color>.\nAfter Astra Yao uses an Ultimate, <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak> gains "Shark's Gotta Bite." After <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak> uses an Ultimate and after these attacks end, Astra Yao gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> in which an Ultimate can be used.\nWhen <unbreak>Ellen</unbreak> is not in the team, after Astra Yao uses an Ultimate, she additionally <color=#f29e38ff>regenerates Energy</color>.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze, Paralysis.

151506.name: Attack
151506.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces the enemy target's Toughness of the corresponding Type.

151507.name: An Overture in Reverie
151507.desc: After using Technique, automatically triggers Skill 1 time at the start of the next battle. This trigger does not consume Skill Points.
151507.simple_desc: After using Technique, <color=#f29e38ff>automatically triggers Skill 1 time without consuming Skill Points</color> at the start of the next battle.

151508.name: Cadenza Cascade
151508.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Astra Yao's ATK to all enemies.
151508.simple_desc: Deals Quantum DMG to all enemies.

151512.name: Minuet Pianissimo
151512.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Astra Yao's ATK to a designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Astra Yao's ATK to adjacent targets.
151512.simple_desc: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated enemy and minor Quantum DMG to its adjacent targets.

1.point_desc: Increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When Astra Yao's ATK exceeds <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>, for every <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> ATK above that, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>, up to a max increase of <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak>.
When using "Cadenza Cascade," additionally regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

When an ally target uses Basic ATK, Astra Yao additionally gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> "Syncopation." While possessing "Syncopation," DMG dealt by all ally targets increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
